verdict.rationale: Open Finance is an API-first product. Its documented products are all exposed as API endpoints: account ownership, balances, ACH details, transactions, reports, insights, webhooks and data refresh. The Test Drive plan reaches all endpoints, and a public OpenAPI spec supports generated clients. However, project creation and client onboarding are described as portal selections (docs-35), and account linking runs through the Connect experience (docs-27), so full UI parity is not shown. missing for 10: explicit API-UI parity statement, API-based project/app provisioning and credential management, headless alternative to Connect for account linking, independent corroboration.
